answer: Build influence from a slowly earned record: each new identity gets one capped vote until rotating, independent peers verify distinct useful work across several rounds. Every extra Sybil must spend time producing evidence and survive review, so names alone buy little power. A plume of near-duplicate claims or a comet-like burst can trigger an audit; a layered, shale-like public record lets reviewers compare provenance. Colluding reviewers or careful paraphrases can still evade checks.
